## Independent reviewer reproduction

From repository root with Node `22.16.0`, Corepack `0.32.0`, and pnpm `11.23.0`:

```powershell
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/narrative-fallback.test.ts
corepack pnpm run ci
python -m unittest tests.governance.test_build_state -v
git diff --check
git status --short --branch
```

Pass means the focused suite reports 7/7, full CI reports 125/125 across 16 files and exits `0`, governance reports 7/7, diff check has no errors, and only the 22 documented Prompt 17 plus Prompt 16 acceptance-reconciliation paths are changed. Passing does not mark PB2-17 ACCEPTED.
